span.p: C. 每个 Fabric 资源 Stage 共用的持久化协议

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. Authoritative Read
Owner: Fabric -> Tencent provider
职责: 先判断 absent / pending / ready / unknown
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Reserve Attempt
Owner: Control Plane PostgreSQL
职责: CAS 保存 attempt=1、idempotency key、有限 read budget
规则: CAS loser 不调用外部系统
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Persist Immutable Binding
Owner: Fabric PostgreSQL
职责: provider 写入前 claim Fabric Operation
保存: Launch/Account/Workspace/stage/action/op ID/key/hash/expected binding
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Bounded Mutation
Owner: Tencent adapter
职责: 仅操作已授权 exact CVM/TKE/CBS/Kubernetes target
规则: prepaid monthly；不推断 owner
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Provider Readback
Owner: Tencent Cloud / Kubernetes authority
职责: 返回 ownership、status、identity、Ready/imageID 等事实
规则: API 未报错不等于成功
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. Persist Provider Result
Owner: Fabric PostgreSQL
职责: 保存 provider state、resource refs、status/error
规则: identity drift -> conflict；unknown 不伪装 absent
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. Advance Same Business Operation
Owner: Control Plane PostgreSQL
职责: 校验 typed observation 后 CAS 推进 stage cursor
规则: 只推进原 Operation，不创建 successor Launch
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
客户确认购买
Owner: Customer / Console
职责: 提交 packageId、name、autoRenew、intentId
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Preflight
Owner: Control Plane + Fabric
职责: Session/CSRF/Account/Package/Guard、Provider capacity/plan
持久化: 外部写入前只读；不创建 Provider 资源
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Claim one Workspace Launch Operation
Owner: Control Plane PostgreSQL
职责: 固定 Account/Workspace/Package/价格/镜像/Request Hash
持久化: stage + version + attempts + observations + lease/CAS
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Key Stage
Owner: Sub2API；协调 Owner: Control Plane
职责: 创建/收敛 exact Workspace Key
持久化: CP 先 reserve attempt/idempotency，再保存 Key ID/fingerprint readback
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Debit Stage
Owner: Sub2API；协调 Owner: Control Plane
职责: 幂等扣除一个月 accepted quote
持久化: CP 保存 pre/post balance、confirmation、period facts
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute
Owner: Fabric / Tencent adapter
职责: CVM/TKE allocation + Machine Ownership
持久化: Fabric Operation + machine_ownership
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute Concurrency Review
Owner: Fabric + Instance qualification owner
职责: 证明同 NodePool 并发 Launch 不重复 scale/claim
当前约束: Pilot 有限 in-flight；typed Launch 未单独证明 pool-head 并发链
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: TENCENT-COMPUTE-POOL-CONCURRENCY-01
Next Evidence: same-nodepool concurrency receipt

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Storage
Owner: Fabric / Tencent adapter
职责: CBS volume + static storage binding
持久化: Fabric provider state + Storage ref
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attachment
Owner: Fabric / Tencent adapter
职责: exact Compute/Volume attachment
持久化: exact attachment ID + Operation binding
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Secret
Owner: Fabric / Tencent adapter
职责: 将 Workspace Key 写入 Kubernetes Secret
持久化: 只保存 Secret ref/version/fingerprint；不保存 raw Key
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Runtime
Owner: Fabric / Tencent adapter
职责: Deployment/Pod/Service、password auth、Workspace URL readback
持久化: Runtime ID/service/access refs + Ready facts
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: PORTABLE-INSTALL-01、INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Activation
Owner: Control Plane PostgreSQL
职责: 原子写 Workspace entitlement 与资源/访问投影
前提: Runtime authoritative ready
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(23, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Purchase Receipt
Owner: Ledger PostgreSQL
职责: append-only receipt + idempotency key + request hash
Control Plane 将 Receipt ID 保存到原 Launch Operation
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Activation -> Receipt 一致性窗口
Owner: Control Plane projection + Ledger
职责: 中断后只补原 Receipt；Ledger 保持 Receipt 权威
当前行为: budget exhausted 可进入 manual_review；Workspace purchase_receipt_id 未同步
影响: Billing/Admin 读模型漏 ref；Permanent Delete 仍由 Launch Operation + Ledger 校验
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: WORKSPACE-PURCHASE-RECEIPT-PROJECTION-01
Next Evidence: Operation/Ledger/Workspace 同一 Receipt ref + 零重复 mutation

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TKE End-to-End Evidence
Owner: opl-instance-medopl
职责: 正常购买、Provider/Runtime/Billing readback、workspace_verified
状态: BLOCKED
Gap: INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01
Next Evidence: 同一 current Candidate 的受保护 workflow receipt
